title: Fix path traversal in MemoryGovernanceServices — sanitize user-controlled file paths
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
- **2 instances** in `MemorySmith.App/Services/MemoryGovernanceServices.cs` (L503, L505)
- One instance rated **Blocker** severity by SonarQube

## Impact
Path traversal attack — filesystem paths constructed from user-controlled data allow an attacker to read/write arbitrary files outside the intended directory.

## Action Required
Sanitize user input, use `Path.GetFullPath()` combined with prefix checks against the allowed base directory, or implement a whitelist-based path resolution strategy.

## Effort
~1h

## Priority
P0 — Security
